items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

ctx.x: Oh my first name — Billie Jane Lee Lorraine — well I was called Billie or Billie Jane for the first few years of my life and for some reason I think I didn’t like Billie and Feather together. And I said, “I want you to call me Lorraine.” They gave me four names. Apparently, and I didn’t even realize this until somebody sent me a letter my dad had

written to this person’s dad way back in the day saying that there were a lot of arguments about my name and that’s why they wound up giving me four. But it was, you know, Billie for Billie Holiday. When my mother was pregnant Billie Holiday said, “Oh I want to be the Godmother” so of course they wanted to have that connection. And they called me Billie. Jane for my mom, Lee for Peggy Lee, and Lorraine for the song “Sweet Lorraine.” So I guess it just dawned on me slowly why they called me all those things. But…
Have you ever thought about trying to write a lyric about that?
